desc: Our Chaos series fixed blades are equipped with unique "D" ring guards made from reinforced 6061 aluminum, allowing for an incredibly secure and comfortable grip while protecting the hand both from incoming attack and damage while striking or cutting an opponent who's covered in body armor, ammo, flashlights, magazines and gear. The extra thick 1055 carbon steel pommels are tapered to concentrate the percussive force of a hammering strike and their full tang SK-5 High Carbon steel blades are expertly heat treated for maximum performance. Includes Secure-Ex sheath, MOLLE-Lok and Tek-Lok compatible, with rugged adjustable Cor-Ex belt loops and retaining straps for a secure and reliable lock up when not in use.
